# Cloud Standard

## Purpose

Define organization-wide cloud expectations at a structural level.

## Scope

- Applies to cloud-oriented work across profiles and capabilities.
- Describes ownership boundaries for cloud guidance.
- Leaves provider-specific implementation detail to modules or future standards.

## Ownership

- Primary owner: cloud platform maintainers.
- Reviewers: engineering, security, and observability stakeholders.

## Review Process

- Keep guidance concise and reusable.
- Confirm the standard reflects organizational expectations, not technology tutorials.
- Prefer references to policy themes over implementation steps.

## Future Content

- Cloud governance themes.
- Environment boundary expectations.
- Resource lifecycle expectations.
- Platform review checkpoints.
